signature: settings_customise_sources(cls, settings_cls, init_settings, env_settings, dotenv_settings, file_secret_settings) -> tuple
pre_condition: settings_cls is a Pydantic BaseSettings subclass whose model config enforces extra='forbid'; init_settings is a Pydantic InitSettingsSource instance; _CONFIG_PATH is accessible in this scope
post_condition: Returns a tuple of two settings sources. The first element is init_settings unchanged. The second element is a new _LayeredSource instance. When Pydantic evaluates the returned sources in order, any field set in init_settings takes precedence over the same field in the _LayeredSource. No other Pydantic-specific settings sources (env_settings, dotenv_settings, file_secret_settings) appear in the returned tuple.
